title: Foundation
blurb: Absolute-beginner track: basic data structures and algorithms with visualizers, short summaries, and further reading.

steps.title: Arrays: indexed storage
steps.summary: Arrays store items side by side so any index reads in O(1). Inserting or deleting in the middle shifts everything after it, which costs O(n).

steps.title: Two Sum
steps.summary: First hashing pattern: trade one pass plus a lookup table for the naive pair check.

steps.title: Contains Duplicate
steps.summary: Same set-membership idea as Two Sum, reduced to a yes/no duplicate check.

steps.title: Sorting basics
steps.summary: Sorting arranges data so binary search and two-pointer scans work. Watch how many comparisons each method needs.

steps.title: Binary search step-through
steps.summary: On sorted data, halving the search range each step finds any item in O(log n).

steps.title: Binary Search
steps.summary: Classic halving invariant on a sorted array: test midpoint, discard half in O(log n).

steps.title: Valid Palindrome
steps.summary: Converging two pointers: compare the ends and walk inward.

steps.title: Move Zeroes
steps.summary: Two pointers in-place: slow write pointer tracks zeros while fast pointer scans.

steps.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
steps.summary: Variable sliding window: stretch the right edge, shrink from the left on duplicates.

steps.title: Singly linked list
steps.summary: Nodes linked by pointers: O(1) inserts at a known spot, O(n) access by index.

steps.title: Reverse Linked List
steps.summary: Rewire each node's pointer to its predecessor in one pass.

steps.title: Linked List Cycle
steps.summary: Fast-slow pointer chase: detect cycles in O(n) time and O(1) space.

steps.title: LIFO stack
steps.summary: Last-in first-out: pushes and pops cost O(1) and power bracket matching and undo histories.

steps.title: Valid Parentheses
steps.summary: Push opening brackets, match closers off the top of the stack.

steps.title: Hash map buckets
steps.summary: Keys hash to buckets for average O(1) put and get; collisions chain inside a bucket.

steps.title: Valid Anagram
steps.summary: Count characters with a frequency map, then compare the counts.

steps.title: Tree traversals
steps.summary: Inorder, preorder, and postorder each visit every node once; order decides what problems they fit.

steps.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
steps.summary: Postorder depth: one plus the deeper of the two child depths.

steps.title: Same Tree
steps.summary: Simultaneous recursive walk: structural and value equality across two trees.

steps.title: Foundation check
steps.summary: Mixed beginner questions across the structures above.
